name: B10-0159/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep backing Ukraine against Russia's war and to do more. It asks for more weapons and money for Ukraine, tougher sanctions on Russia, and holding Russian leaders responsible for war crimes. It also warns that Europe can no longer count on the United States and must build up its own defence. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks for more military aid, sanctions and defence spending.
- **Who it affects:** Ukraine, Russia, EU governments and European taxpayers.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide whether to act on these requests.
